name: Imouto☆Love Me!! ~Onii Nanka Zenzen Suki Janain Dakara ne!!~
original_name: 妹☆らぶみー!! ～お兄なんかぜんぜん好きじゃないんだからねっ!!～
source:
One summer my parents had a situation. I was asked to take care of my little sister at our beach house. 
She was cute to look at but when she opened her mouth she was pure garbage. 
With big worries and small hopes for my own fun, I began the bizarre summer vacation... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106167.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一年夏天，我的父母遇到了一种情况。我被要求在我们的海滨别墅照顾我的小妹妹。
看上去很可爱，但张开嘴就完全是个垃圾。
怀着大忧愁和小希望，我开始了奇异的暑假…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106167.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
